operations.title: Administration
operations.subtitle: Powerful tools to manage and transform your budget data across different years and columns.

cards.freezeDesc: Lock budget columns or headcount metrics for a specific year
cards.copyBudgetDesc: Copy budget data between years and columns with optional percentage adjustments
cards.copyAllocDesc: Copy allocation methods and percentages from one year to another
cards.resetColumnDesc: Clear all data from a budget column for a specific year
cards.allocationDefaultDesc: Choose the method applied to OPEX and CAPEX items left on the default allocation
cards.budgetRowsDesc: Export or import the monthly amounts of every OPEX and CAPEX line, one row per line, year and column.

allocationDefault.title: Default allocation method
allocationDefault.subtitle: Choose how costs are shared across companies by default, for each fiscal year.
allocationDefault.modeManualHelp: The driver is applied to the selected companies only.
allocationDefault.companiesHint: Select at least one company: the selection is saved when the list closes.
allocationDefault.methodHelp: Applies to every OPEX and CAPEX item that uses the default method. Items with an explicit method or a manual allocation are not affected.
allocationDefault.sharesEmpty: No split yet. Select at least one company to see the percentages.
allocationDefault.previewError: The current selection cannot be computed: {{reason}}
allocationDefault.standardNote: Standard method — no override configured for this year.
allocationDefault.overriddenNote: Configured for your organisation. Standard method: {{method}}.
allocationDefault.scopeNote: The method is resolved when allocations are computed: either from the headcount, IT users or turnover of every company enabled for the year, or from the driver value of the companies selected for the default. Changing it re-drives every item left on the default method; manual allocations keep their percentages.
allocationDefault.loadError: Could not load the default allocation method.
allocationDefault.saveError: Could not save the default allocation method.
allocationDefault.noPermission: You need budget administration rights to change the default. The current setting stays visible.

freeze.title: Freeze / unfreeze data
freeze.noPermission: You need Budget Admin permissions to freeze or unfreeze data. You can still review the current freeze status below.
freeze.loadError: Failed to load freeze status. Try selecting a different year.

columnReset.title: Reset budget column
columnReset.subtitle: Clear a column for one year, for OPEX or CAPEX: its twelve months and its spread period.
columnReset.columnFrozenError: The {{year}} {{column}} column is frozen. Unfreeze it before clearing data.
columnReset.noDataInfo: The {{column}} column of {{year}} holds no amount. Clearing only removes its spread periods.
columnReset.clearFailed: The reset failed. Nothing was changed.
columnReset.clearWarning_one: Clearing removes the {{column}} amounts and period of {{year}} for {{count}} item. This cannot be undone.
columnReset.clearWarning_other: Clearing removes the {{column}} amounts and period of {{year}} for {{count}} items. This cannot be undone.
columnReset.confirmAffected_one: {{count}} item is affected, for a total of {{value}}.
columnReset.confirmAffected_other: {{count}} items are affected, for a total of {{value}}.
columnReset.confirmPeriodsOnly: The {{column}} column for {{year}} holds no amount. Only its spread periods will be removed.

copyAllocations.title: Copy allocations
copyAllocations.subtitle: Copy allocation methods and percentages from one year to another, for OPEX or CAPEX.
copyAllocations.sameYearWarning: Source and destination years must be different.
copyAllocations.showingItems: Showing {{total}} items. {{toCopy}} will be copied, {{skipped}} skipped, {{errors}} errors.
copyAllocations.dryRunPrompt: Run a dry run to preview how allocation methods will be copied.
copyAllocations.skippedDueToDestination: {{count}} items already have allocations in {{year}}. Enable overwrite to replace them.
copyAllocations.summaryReady: {{processed}} items ready to copy, {{skipped}} skipped, {{errors}} errors.
copyAllocations.dryRunFailed: Dry run failed. Check the console for details.
copyAllocations.copyFailed: Copy failed. Check the console for details.
copyAllocations.defaultBasisWarning: {{count}} items are left on the default allocation: {{destinationYear}} uses {{destinationLabel}} while {{sourceYear}} uses {{sourceLabel}}. Copied items keep following the default of their own year — configure {{destinationYear}} in Budget administration if the basis should stay the same.

copyBudgetColumns.title: Copy budget columns
copyBudgetColumns.subtitle: Copy a column to another year or column, for OPEX or CAPEX. Each month keeps its amount, and the percentage applies to every month.
copyBudgetColumns.frozenError: The {{year}} {{column}} column is frozen. Unfreeze it before copying data.
copyBudgetColumns.copyFailed: The copy failed. Nothing was changed.
copyBudgetColumns.roundingNote: With a percentage, amounts are rounded to whole amounts.
copyBudgetColumns.previewInfo_one: {{count}} item in the preview: {{toProcess}} to copy, {{skipped}} skipped. Skipped items keep their current value.
copyBudgetColumns.previewInfo_other: {{count}} items in the preview: {{toProcess}} to copy, {{skipped}} skipped. Skipped items keep their current value.
copyBudgetColumns.existingDataWarning_one: {{count}} item already has an amount in the destination column and will be skipped. Turn on "Overwrite existing data" to replace it.
copyBudgetColumns.existingDataWarning_other: {{count}} items already have an amount in the destination column and will be skipped. Turn on "Overwrite existing data" to replace them.

currency.title: Currency settings
currency.subtitle: Configure reporting and default currencies used across OPEX and CAPEX workflows. All values are saved as three-letter ISO codes.
currency.loadError: Failed to load current currency settings.
currency.fxSyncRunning: FX rates sync is already running in the background.
currency.fxSyncStarted: FX rates sync started for fiscal years {{years}}. Rates will update shortly.
currency.reportingCurrencyHelp: Primary currency used for reports and totals
currency.defaultOpexCurrencyHelp: Prefills currency when creating new OPEX items
currency.defaultCapexCurrencyHelp: Prefills currency when creating new CAPEX items
currency.allowedCurrenciesHelp: Optional comma-separated list (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP)
currency.fxRatesTitle: Latest FX rate snapshots (per fiscal year, tenant reporting currency basis)
currency.loadRatesError: Failed to load FX rate history.
currency.noRatesYet: No FX rate snapshots captured yet. Run "Force FX rates sync" to create one.

budgetRows.title: Budget rows file
budgetRows.intro: One row per line, year and column, with the period of the column and its twelve monthly amounts. The export covers the OPEX and CAPEX lines you can read.
budgetRows.importRules: An import replaces the twelve months of each row in the file. Identical rows are left untouched, and the whole file is checked before anything is saved.
